description: This file implements the QuicClientDefaultNetworkHelper class and related classes/functions for managing UDP sockets and network events in a QUIC client context.

classes.name: LevelTriggeredPacketWriter
classes.description: A packet writer class for level-triggered socket I/O, rearming the socket when it gets blocked.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndBind
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket to a specified address and port.

methods.name: CleanUpUDPSocket
methods.description: Cleans up a specific UDP socket.

methods.name: CleanUpAllUDPSockets
methods.description: Cleans up all managed UDP sockets.

methods.name: RunEventLoop
methods.description: Runs a single iteration of the system event loop.

methods.name: OnSocketEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events such as readability and writability.

methods.name: CreateQuicPacketWriter
methods.description: Creates a packet writer, choosing between edge-triggered and level-triggered implementations.

methods.name: SetClientPort
methods.description: Sets the client port in the internal address map.

methods.name: GetLatestClientAddress
methods.description: Returns the most recent client address.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocket
methods.description: Creates a UDP socket with specified address family and buffer sizes.

methods.name: BindInterfaceNameIfNeeded
methods.description: Binds a socket to a specific network interface if specified.
